title: WPMS/1079/2017 of Sanjay Kumar Vs Nagar Palika Parishad Nainital AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 1079 of 2017
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
 Mr. Vipul Sharma, Advocate present for the
petitioner.
 Mr. D.S. Patni, Advocate present for
respondent nos. 1 & 2.
 Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate present for
respondent no. 3.
 Private respondent no. 3, who is being
represented by Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate has
given a statement before this Court that he has no
objection.
 Learned counsel for the Municipal Board,
Mr. D.S. Patni states that he has no objection if the
petition is allowed and the petitioner is permitted to
participated in the bid, in accordance with law.
 In view of the above statements, since the
petitioner is being allowed to participate, nothing
further needs to be done.
 Petition is disposed of in terms of the above
undertaking of the counsel for the Municipal
Board.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 31.05.2017
Avneet/
